entities.title: Looks as designed
entities.summary: Every screen state renders like its reference image.
entities.requirement: With the reference scenario loaded at 1440 × 900, each of the 23 states matches its reference render: layout within 2 px, the same text, fonts and UI colours, the 3D scene within a small tolerance.
entities.measuredBy: scripts/reference/render.sh, compared with docs/screens/ with the masked areas excluded.

entities.title: Readable and keyboard-reachable
entities.summary: Text contrast and keyboard use as UI-DESIGN.md sets them.
entities.requirement: Ink on card at least 14.7 : 1, muted 5.7 : 1, gold 9.0 : 1; every button focusable and pressable with Enter or Space; Escape closes the promotion picker and list pages; results are told in words, not colour alone.
entities.measuredBy: Reading the theme's colours against the ratios; trying the screens with the keyboard.

origin.description: Gambit's UI design: Keyboard and accessibility.

entities.details: The board itself is driven by mouse or touch only.

entities.title: Runs without cross-origin isolation
entities.summary: WebGL 2 and a single-threaded export, so any browser with WebGL 2 runs the game without special headers.
entities.requirement: The web export uses the Compatibility renderer and no threads, and Stockfish its single-threaded build, so neither needs SharedArrayBuffer or cross-origin isolation headers.
entities.measuredBy: export_presets.cfg (thread_support off, no cross-origin isolation headers) and project.godot (gl_compatibility); the stockfish-19-lite-single files build.mjs copies.

origin.description: Decision log: Compatibility renderer, single-threaded web export (no cross-origin isolation needed).

entities.title: Every static file under 25 MiB
entities.summary: Cloudflare serves static files of at most 25 MiB; Godot's engine is about 39.5 MB.
entities.requirement: No file in dist/ is over 25 MiB: build.mjs cuts index.wasm into 20 MiB parts and the Worker streams them back as one index.wasm.
entities.measuredBy: build.mjs's PART size, and joinedWasm streaming up to 8 parts.

origin.description: Gambit's README, written for players and developers.

entities.details: joinedWasm reads at most eight parts, 160 MiB.

entities.title: No writes from other sites
entities.summary: Every write is JSON from the game's own origin, behind the host's cookie.
entities.requirement: The API refuses a POST that is not JSON or whose Origin is another site; the session cookie is the host's site_session (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax); the page's Content-Security-Policy allows only this origin, wss://icelander.net and Cloudflare's analytics.
entities.measuredBy: The API test that a cross-site write is 403; web/_headers.

origin.description: Gambit's README, written for players and developers.

entities.title: Only what invitations and contacts need
entities.summary: Gambit keeps a player's name, email address and profile picture, and their games; nothing else.
entities.requirement: The users table holds address, name, picture address and two times; challenges, games with their transcripts, and contacts are the rest. Pictures are fetched through the Worker, only from Google's and GitHub's image hosts, so the page loads nothing from elsewhere.
entities.measuredBy: worker/schema.sql; the sign-in card's text; safePicture and the avatar route.

origin.description: Gambit's README, written for players and developers.

entities.title: An idle game costs nothing
entities.requirement: A game's Durable Object accepts its players' sockets with the hibernation API, so a game waiting for a move keeps no object running.
entities.measuredBy: GameRoom.fetch uses ctx.acceptWebSocket and webSocketMessage rather than holding sockets itself.

origin.description: The file's opening comment: their sockets hibernate between moves, so an idle game costs nothing.
